_comment: 2026-09-29 VOLUME / VOLATILITY FILTERS (founder: "everything as filters to fully understand what works"): generic gates rvol_min/rvol_max/rvol_bars (relative minute volume) and vt_risk_usd/vt_qty_max (volatility-targeted size) on OrbConfig — live and paper; trend modes atr_break (open/prev_close ± k×day ATR) and vprofile (prior-session POC / value area, break or fade to the POC). 90-variant matrix (label volgrid): rvol ≥2.5 +$33/ct but 3 trades vs 20; rvol ≥1.5 +$11/ct, net −$23; quiet tape (rvol ≤0.8) −$10/ct; vol-targeting = size only ($/ct unchanged); atr_break and vprofile negative/tiny on six sessions. All in the fleet. 2026-09-29 beta_on_1800 (+__htf): the Tradeify-compatible overnight hold — enter at the 18:00 ET Globex reopen, out 09:30; stays inside one session, so unlike beta_on (15:55 entry) it does not cross the 16:45 close. 2026-09-29 BETA EXPOSURE (founder: "for now add the rest in leaderboard rotation" — paper only): trend-engine mode `hold` (enter at a clock time, out at the window end, position survives the 18:00 reset; paper-broker windows may wrap midnight) — beta_on (15:55→09:30 long, the overnight premium), __htf (4h EMA-20 trend filter), _tom (turn of month), _prefomc (day before fomc/nfp), _short (control), beta_close (15:00→15:59 on up days), beta_day (09:30→15:55). Wide stop 150 / no trail; 1 MNQ. NOT live-runnable: Tradeify forbids holding through 17:00 CT and the live EOD logic does not wrap. 2026-09-29 FOUNDER: "we want all to keep running for ever and get stats per week, month, year" — EVERY registered strategy runs, nothing is pruned again (the 09-26 retirements re-enabled, the 466 research ids from the 09-28 grids added). The leaderboard and the Periodic view judge them by week / month / year. 2026-09-28 EXIT-SIDE REGIME (regime_exit_min_eff / trail_step_trend / trail_step_range / tp_r_range, both sides, parity-tested) + the CONTROL that explained it: on 8 bases the regime-switched exits beat the base 8/8 (+$199/variant), but a PLAIN trail_step 25 (label tr25) beat the base by more on 7 of 8 (orb_t1000_2nd_5 $198→$746, fib day $394→$703, ichimoku $289→$696). The gain is the wider trail, not the split. Eight __tr25 keepers forward-test; regime-exit ids stay registered but disabled. FOLLOW-UP: sweep trail 25/35/50 and put 25 to the founder for the live hand-off (its trail is 15). 2026-09-28 COMBINED GATES (book fade imbalance_max 0.45 + regime nochase/trend) on the fib/ORB-2nd bases: 1-2 trades each in six sessions, all losers (label combo) — the two gates block each other; NOT combined, rows kept disabled. 2026-09-28 FOUR NEW TREND MODES (orb_retest, gap_fade, news_break, ib_break; calendar event days via set_event_day): 28-variant grid (label newmodes) — gap_fade 2/2 winners (+$124, two gap days only), news_break 14:00 5/5 small (+$23), news_break 08:30 flat, ib_break negative (PF 0.35), orb_retest flat-to-negative (mostly BE scratches). Four keepers forward-test; the rest stay registered but disabled. 2026-09-28 TAKE-PROFIT (tp_points / tp_r, OrderManager + paper broker, parity-tested): 96-variant grid (label tpgrid) says a fixed target LOSES on average at every R (tp1 −$79/variant, tp1.5 −$62, tp2 −$48, tp3 −$25 vs base) — it caps the trailing runners that carry the fleet; only 3R on the classic ORB bases was neutral-to-positive. Five __tp* ORB keepers forward-test; fib/trend bases must NOT get a fixed target. 2026-09-28 REGIME GATE (paper_quote.hpp RegimeState — session shape since 09:30 vs prior-day ATR14; keys regime_min/max_range_atr, regime_min/max_eff, regime_min/max_move_atr, regime_with_move ±1, regime_min_minutes; off by default, same gate live). 144-variant replay (label rggrid, config/paper_regime_research.json): five gates on 24 bases — no gate raised net P&L on average over six sessions (they block 55-80 % of entries, mostly the 30-min warm-up), rg_nochase (max 0.5 ATR from the open) and rg_trend (eff ≥0.5 with the move) were the best per contract. Eight __rg_* keepers forward-test from tonight; the rest stay registered but disabled. 2026-09-28 FIB EXIT/WINDOW RESEARCH (founder: "find more trades and optimize these trades"): 162-variant replay grid over 09-21..09-28 (labels fibgrid/fibgrid2, config/paper_fib_research*.json) — trail_be_trigger 3 was the worst exit in every combination (11 of 18 live-twin trades scratched at +$0.50 with 6 pts MFE), trail_step 15 > 10 > 6, sl 8 > 12, deep zone 0.5-0.786 > 0.382 zones, swing 30 > 20/45, cap 8 adds trades not P&L, 12:00-13:00 is the weak hour. Keepers added as __am_x15 / __am_x15b / __day_x15 / __day_x15_m8 (forward test); __day_x15 is the live hand-off twin. 2026-09-26 evening (founder: do 1,3,4,6,7,10 + the rest): PRUNED (enabled:false, rows kept) nr7 / supertrend / roc_momentum / trend_day, every globex_* whole-day id and the book overlays __micro __imb __all __sz __wait __bx __bbe — none earned on the 7-day forward test; __pm set removed (backfill did not support it); __open siblings added for every 1-minute trend base (all 9 first ones were positive); __inv added on the new __am/__open winners. TIME-OF-DAY WINDOWS 2026-09-26 (63): __am entries 10:00-12:00 ET (the hand-off slot; mtf via session_window), __pm 13:30-15:55 (afternoon mean reversion), __open 09:30-10:00; __am_htf/__am_chand/__am_ts add the never-varied generic knobs (htf gate 15m, chandelier 2 ATR, 45-min time stop) to the four AM winners; volume_burst_*/delta_div_* grid deepens the two tape modes. Rationale: the 7-day leaderboard by slot showed the same modes winning in one hour and losing in another. BOOK OVERLAYS round 2 (bases with ≥2 live trades, 105): __inv inverted imbalance, __bx book-flip exit, __bbe BE on flip, __btp take-profit into pressure, __sz size on agreement, __wait fill timing. BOOK OVERLAYS: 716 sibling variants (<base>__sg spread gate 1.5x rolling, __imb bid-share 0.55, __micro microprice lead, __all) of 179 bases — never edit a base, compare via base_id/overlay; + 10 book_imbalance family. ACCOUNT ENVELOPE OFF (daily_loss_limit/trailing_drawdown_cap = 0): 197 strategies x 1 MNQ on one $25k envelope is not an account, and a $1k trailing cap halted the whole research fleet on 2026-09-22 after a +3.1k/-2.6k day. Risk unit = per-strategy strategy_daily_loss_limit. Paper fleet across ALL sessions (Asia 20:00–02:30, London 02:30–07:30, US pre-market, RTH, US evening, whole Globex day): 161 trend-engine variants (26 modes: trend, failed-breakout, Keltner, Ichimoku, ROC, delta, fib, ema ribbon, thrust fade, absorption reversal / delta divergence / volume burst (tape), mean-reversion VWAP/band/RSI2, htf gate, chandelier) + 57 ORB variants (09:30 range sweep + other session times/timeframes + entry/management rules) + 25 MTF scalpers (HTF choices, trigger modes, sessions, direction) on one tradeify paper account. Base params = config/tradeify_config.json; per-strategy params override named OrbConfig/MtfScalperConfig fields. Consumed by paper_engine (ticks from PostgreSQL, no Rithmic session). feed_symbol = what the collector writes (NQ front-month); symbol = traded label (MNQ). reference_symbol (ES) feeds the MTF SMT/intermarket module as 1m bars.
